messages.content: I'm not sure about this contract. There's a lot of legal jargon that I don't understand.

Let me take a look. Hmm, well, it looks like you're agreeing to work for the company for three years. They'll provide you with training and pay for your travel expenses. In return, you'll be expected to complete certain tasks and objectives.
Yeah, I know all that. But what does this part mean? "The company reserves the right to terminate this agreement at any time, with or without cause"?
That just means that they can end the contract early if they want to, for any reason or no reason at all. Basically, they have all the power and you have none. Not very fair, is it?
No, not really... But I guess there's not much I can do about it.
Thank you. I'll continue to work hard for you and the company.
Hey Gweneth, can I go to the park?
Yes, you can go to the park.
Yay! I love going to the park!
I know you do. You always have a lot of fun when you go there.
I run there as fast as I can so that I can spend more time there!
Me too, Alexys. But we have to make the best of what we have.
Hey, I don't think I've ever seen you before. What's your name?
I'm Brion. Nice to meet you.
Carlyn. So, what do you do?
I'm a musician. I play the violin in the town orchestra.
That's cool! I wish I could play an instrument. What made you choose the violin?
Fine. I guess I can live with that.
I'm glad you're here, I've been wanting to talk to you about something.
What's up?
I invented something, and I want to get a patent for it.
That's great! What is it?
It's called a catalytic converter. It reduces harmful emissions from vehicles.
Wow, that's really creepy. Do you think it could really happen?
Mom, I'm doing some research on our family tree and I found out that we're related to a famous politician. Can you tell me more about our ancestors?
Sure, Alonso. Our family has a long history in politics. Your great-great-grandfather was a senator, and your great-grandfather was the governor of the state.
Wow, I had no idea. What else can you tell me about them?
Well, your great-great-grandfather was a very important senator. He was one of the first senators from our state. And he was also very involved in the abolitionist movement.
That's amazing! I had no idea our family was so involved in politics. Do you know anything else about them?
Well, your great-grandfather was also a very important politician. He was the governor of the state for many years. And he was also very involved in the civil rights movement.
Adryan, I'm so glad you're here. I've been feeling really down lately and could use a friend.
Of course, Karima. I'm always here for you. What's going on? You can tell me anything, you know that.
I know. It's just been a tough few weeks. My parents are getting divorced, my best friend moved away, and I'm failing one of my classes. I feel like I can't do anything right lately.

Man up guys." McKenna said rolling her eyes and taking another step closer to the group of girls who where cat calling them now and making crude remarks about their mothers and other sexual body parts they would like to do with them."Fine don't listen to me but when some strange man corners you in an alley asking for money or whatever don't come crying to me." McKenna finished saying as she turned around walking back the way they had come from leaving her two friends behind who continued to get harassed by the group of girls who where still yelling obscenities at them until they where out of earshot before turning there attention back on each other .
Karima, I'm sorry to hear about everything that's going on. It sounds like it's been really tough for you. But I'm here for you, and we'll get through it together. I promise.
Thanks, McKenna. Just knowing you're here for me makes me feel a little better. I don't know what I would do without you.
Hey, mind if I talk to you for a second?
Yeah, sure. What's up?
I was just talking to some people and I heard that you're not too confident in your intelligence. Is that true?
Yeah, I guess so. It feels like I have to prove myself all the time and people are always judging me.
I can relate to that. I've felt like that before too. It's hard when you feel like you're constantly being compared to other people and falling short.
Exactly! It's like no matter what I do, it's never good enough.
I'm sorry I couldn't do better.
You're not a failure, Ronald. You gave it your all and sometimes that's just not enough. I'm proud of you for how hard you fought out there.
Thank you, coach. It just feels like I let everyone down.
I know it feels that way, but trust me when I say that you didn't. We all knew what the outcome was going to be before the game even started. It's not on you, kiddo.
I know, but it still sucks.
Yeah, it does. But you have to pick yourself up and keep going. You can't let this define who you are as a person or an athlete. Do you understand?
I can't take this anymore. I'm sorry, but I'm quitting.
Wyatt, I'm sorry to hear that. Can I ask what the problem is?
It's just that the work is too hard and the hours are too long. I can't keep doing this.
Well, we can try to make some changes to make it easier for you. Maybe we can give you more breaks or shorter shifts.
You really hurt my feelings when you said that I was lazy. It made me feel like you don't respect me or value my work.
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt your feelings. I was just trying to give you some constructive criticism.
But it still hurt my feelings. And I don't appreciate being called lazy. I work hard and I deserve more respect than that.
So, do you like working here?
I'm so happy that we're together, Saif. I love you so much.
I love you too, Abram. I'm really glad we're together too.
I sometimes can't believe that we're together. It feels like a dream.
I know what you mean. It's like we were meant to be together.
Hey, have you seen the black telephone? I can't seem to find it anywhere.
No, I haven't seen it. Where do you think it could be?
I'm not sure. I thought it was on the nightstand, but it's not there. Maybe it's in the living room somewhere.
Let's go look for it together.
There it is! I told you it was probably in the living room somewhere.
Yeah, thanks for helping me look for it.
I've been thinking a lot lately about moving back to my home country.
Really? Why?
I miss my family a lot. And I want to be closer to them as they get older. I can provide support and assistance to them more easily if I am living nearby.
I can understand that. But what about us?
We can still visit each other. And it's not like we're moving to different countries. We'll still be in the same region.
Well, you definitely succeeded! It looks amazing.
I know you're lazy and dishonest.
So what? What are you going to do about it?
I'm not going to do anything about it. I just wanted to let you know that I know.
Well, now you've told me. Is that all?
No, that's not all. I also wanted to let you know that I think you're a bad person.
Then go! You'll have a blast, I promise.
I want to make a better story that will entertain and educate my readers. I need to add more description and detail to the characters and events so they can imagine the story as it unfolds.
That sounds like a great idea! How do you plan on doing that?

Well, I'm going to start by adding more description to the characters. I want my readers to be able to see them in their minds, so I'm going to describe their features, their clothes, and their mannerisms in greater detail. Then, I'm going to add more depth to the plot by including more suspenseful elements and intriguing subplots. Lastly, I'll make sure the ending is satisfying and unexpected.
That's a really deep realization, man. I'm happy for you that you were able to find that peace within yourself.
Jewel, why would you do this?
It just seemed like the only way out. I couldn't keep going through the pain anymore.
But why did you have to take your own life? There are other ways to cope with pain.
I just couldn't see any other way out. I was in so much pain and I didn't know how to deal with it anymore. Taking my own life seemed like the only way to make it stop.
But now you're gone and I'm left here alone. How am I supposed to deal with this?
Arisa, I'm so sorry. I never meant to hurt you like this. I just wish there was another way.
I'm so happy with how this dress turned out! The blue fabric is really pretty and the white collar looks great too. It fits perfectly too, which is a huge plus.
It does look really nice! You did a great job on it.
Thanks, I'm really happy with it. It was a lot of work, but it was worth it.
I can imagine! It looks like a lot of time and effort went into making it.
Yeah, I put a lot of thought into it. I wanted to make sure that everything was perfect.
No, I haven't seen it. But I'm sure it'll turn up.
Hi, sweetie. I brought you a washing machine because I know how much laundry you have to do for your family.
Mom, you didn't have to do that.
I wanted to. I know it will make your life a lot easier. Plus, this model is really nice. You're going to love it.
Thank you so much, Mom. I really appreciate it.
You're welcome, honey. I just want to make your life a little easier. I know how hard you work.
Thanks, Mom.
I just don't get why people have to be so complicated. It's like, can't we all just be honest and straightforward with each other?
I know what you mean. It seems like everyone is always trying to put on a show or act like they're something they're not. It can be exhausting.
Exactly! I just want to be around people who are genuine and easy to get along with. Do you know what I mean?
Yes, I'm sure. I'll be fine.
Hey, so I went through my clothes and I found a few things that I think will fit you.
Reinaldo, you didn't have to do that.
I wanted to. You don't have many clothes of your own and I thought you could use some of mine.
Thank you, Reinaldo. That's really sweet of you.
No problem. So, what do you think? Do any of these pieces work for you?
Let me see... (She looks through the pile of clothes.) Yes, actually, these shirts and this jacket will be perfect. Thank you so much, Reinaldo!
Hey, Dad. Do you think I could sell my old toys?
Why do you want to sell your old toys, Kaci?
Well, I was thinking that I could make some money off of them. And then, with the money I make, I could buy some new toys.
Hmm. That's a valid reason. But are you sure you're okay with selling your old toys? You seem pretty attached to them.
Yeah, I am. I mean, it'll be tough to let them go, but I think it'll be worth it in the end. Plus, like you said, I can always buy new ones with the money I make from selling the old ones.
Well, your great-grandfather was also a very important politician. He was the governor of the state for many years. And he was also very involved in the civil rights movement.
Hey, have you heard that urban legend about the woman who was killed by a man with a knife?
Yeah, I've heard that one. What happened?
Apparently, the woman was walking home from work when she was attacked. The man ran up to her and stabbed her in the stomach.
Yeah, it was a good day. I got to spend time with my friends and family and do some of the things I love.
Hi, Cuauhtemoc!
Hey, Jayleigh. How are you doing today?
I'm doing well, thanks for asking. I wanted to talk to you about something.
Sure, what's up?
Well, I think you're a really great person. You're always so kind and helpful, and you always go out of your way to help others. I just wanted to let you know that I appreciate you as a friend.
Sahara, please. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you. I love you, okay? I really do.
Hey, Mom. I'm trying to decide what to wear tonight and I could use your help.
Of course, sweetie. What's the occasion?
One of my friends is having a small get-together at her house.
Okay, well what do you have in mind?
I was thinking maybe a cute dress or skirt with a top. But I'm not sure if that's too dressy.
Absolutely! So, are you planning on playing any more this week?

I was headed home after school and I saw a big crowd around my friend Jimmy. I asked what happened, and they said he got into a fight with some other guys. Then the police came over to talk to me because apparently, I was the only one who saw what happened.
So you didn't see the actual altercation?
No, I only saw the aftermath. But from what people were saying, it sounded like Jimmy started it.
Do you know why he would've started a fight?
No idea. He's usually a pretty good kid.
I know you will, Makel. I have faith in you. Now go out there and show everyone what you're made of.
Hey, Tayana.
Hey, what's up?
I just wanted to let you know that I really appreciate you looking out for me. It means a lot.
It's no problem, I just want to make sure you're safe.
I know, but it still means a lot. Thank you.
You're welcome. I just want to make sure you're happy and healthy.
Hey, Mom. I got some extra water from the well today.
Oh, thank you, America. Your baby sister is sick, so we need to make sure she stays hydrated.
Yeah, no problem. I'll just collect a few extra buckets each day until she gets better.
That would be great, thank you. We really appreciate it.
It's no problem, Mom. I just want to help out however I can.
You're such a good son, America. I'm really proud of you.
Hey, Dad.
Hey, Son. How are you?
I'm good. Thanks for meeting me.
Of course. It's been a while. How have you been?
I've been good. I've been working a lot and just enjoying life.
Well, thank you anyway. I appreciate it.
So, if something is upside-down, does that mean it can be right-side up again?
Well, that's one way to think about it. Basically, when something is upside-down, it means it's the opposite of what is normally expected.
I see. So, if something is usually up, then it would be down if it's upside-down?
That's right.
And if something is usually left, then it would be right if it's upside-down?
Thanks, Mom.
Hey, Sarah! I'm so glad you could meet me for lunch today.
Hey! Yeah, no problem. I was actually just in the area shopping, so this worked out perfectly.
Oh, cool! Did you find anything good?
Yeah, I got a few things. But nothing as cute as what you're wearing. Where did you get that shirt?
Thanks! I got it at Forever 21. They have really great clothes there, and it's always affordable.
That's exactly what it feels like! I love you, Elanor.
Hey, I found a piece of candy on the ground.
Where did you find it?
Over there. *Points*
Is it safe to eat?
Yeah, I already ate it.
"Well, you've been working hard at it and you finally did it. Good job."
Hi, Milania. I noticed you're sitting over here by yourself and I just wanted to make sure you're okay.
Yeah, I'm fine. Thanks for asking.
No problem! So what's up?
Just thinking about stuff.
What kind of stuff?
Sure, what is it?
Hey boss, what's up?
Not much, just getting some work done. What about you?
I'm just getting some work done too. I really appreciate your praise the other day, it meant a lot to me.
No problem, you deserve it. You're always one of the first to volunteer for projects and you always have a positive attitude. It's great to have someone like you on the team.
Hi, boss. You're looking sharp today.
Thanks, Rusty. You look nice too. Is that a new tie?
Yeah, I thought I should dress up a bit if I want to be taken seriously.
Well, you always look professional and put-together, so I don't think you need to worry about that. But it's good to see you dressing up more often.
Thanks, boss. So what's on the agenda for today?
Well, we've got a lot to go over. I've been looking at the numbers and we need to make some changes.
Hey Joe, can I talk to you for a second?
Yeah, what's up?
I had a realization today and I wanted to share it with you.
Okay, shoot.
I realized that happiness doesn't come from things outside of ourselves, but from within. From that moment on, I was content and at peace with myself.
Arisa, I'm so sorry. I never meant to hurt you like this. I just wish there was another way.
What exactly happened? I want to know so I can move on.
It's complicated. Basically, you were betrayed and hurt by someone you thought you could trust.
Who? What did they do?
I don't want to say right now. Just know that it wasn't your fault and that you didn't deserve what happened.
I deserve to know what happened! Who did this to me?
That does sound like a great style! Layering can be tricky though, how do you make sure that all the pieces work together without looking too cluttered?
Hi, I'm Torri. I noticed you're new here. What's your name?
Hi, I'm Arayah. Yeah, I just moved here from out of state.
Oh, cool. Where did you move from?
I moved from Florida.
That's awesome! I've always wanted to go to Florida. What made you move here?
I'm happy to see you too, Dalilah.

Oh my gosh, Aalyah, I had no idea! I'm so sorry to hear that. What can I do to help you guys out?

Honestly, just knowing that you're here for me makes me feel a little bit better. It's hard seeing my parents struggle like this and not being able to do anything about it. We've just been trying to take things one day at a time.
If there's anything I can do to help out, please let me know. You're not alone in this, Aalyah.
I'm sorry, coach. I know I should've hit the target.
Alayna, what's going on? You used to be one of our best shooters.
I don't know, coach. It's like my mind is somewhere else when I'm shooting.
Where do you think your mind is?
Maybe it's because I'm not sure if I want to do this anymore.
Alright then. If you're sure that's what you want to do, go for it. Just remember to be careful when handling money and negotiating prices with potential buyers.
I can't believe they would do this to me. I thought I was part of the team.

I'm sorry, Ismael. I know you're upset. But you have to understand that sometimes people make decisions based on what they think is best for the group, not necessarily based on personal relationships.
But I thought we were friends! I thought we were working together!

We are still friends, Ismael. And we are still working together. But sometimes people have different ideas about what's best for the group, and when that happens, there has to be a discussion and a vote. That's just the way it is.
It doesn't seem fair.
I know it doesn't seem fair, but that's just how it is. People have to make decisions based on what they think is best for the group as a whole, not just based on personal relationships.
Hey, dad.
Hey, son. How are you doing?
I'm doing good. I was just thinking about how grateful I am for everything in my life.
That's great, son. It's important to be thankful for what we have.
Yeah, I know. I'm lucky to have such a great family and group of friends. And I'm healthy, so that's a plus too.
Absolutely! Those are all wonderful things to be thankful for. You're right, you are very lucky.
I was expecting to get that promotion.
I'm sorry, but we went with someone else.
Why? I've been here longer and I'm more qualified.
The other candidate had more experience.
That's not fair. I've been busting my ass for this company for years and you just give the promotion to someone who doesn't even deserve it.
Eliah, calm down. I understand your frustration, but there's nothing I can do. The decision has been made.
Hey, Dad. I wanted to talk to you about something important.
What's up?
I've been thinking a lot about religion lately.
Oh, yeah? What's got you interested in that?
I don't know. I've just been having these dreams where this figure appears to me and I think it's God.
So, do you like working here?
I'm so glad I took your advice and came out here for the weekend. It's been exactly what I needed.
I'm glad to hear that! What have you been doing to relax?
Well, I've been spending a lot of time walking on the beach, swimming in the ocean, and just generally enjoying the outdoors. It's been really great.
That sounds like a perfect way to spend a weekend getaway. Did you do anything else fun?
Yeah, I actually went on a dolphin tour yesterday. It was really cool to see them up close in their natural habitat.
That's understandable. It can be tough sometimes. If you ever need to talk, I'm here for you.

Not much. Just feeling a little down lately.
That's tough. I'm here for you, though. You can talk to me about anything.
Thanks, Addy. I appreciate that.
It's just been a tough few weeks. First, my cat died, and then I got into a fight with my best friend.
Oh, no! I'm so sorry to hear that. That sounds really tough.
Hey, how are you today?

Yeah, I know what you mean. It can be tough out here on the streets. But it's good to see that there are people like you who are still fighting and trying to make something of themselves.
It's not easy, that's for sure. But I'm just trying to take it one day at a time. That's all I can do, really.
That's a good attitude to have. I'm sure you'll be able to make it through this tough time.
Thanks for the encouragement. It really means a lot.
I can't believe you didn't even recognize me!

I know. I did it for a change.

Yeah, I know. But I just wanted to try something new.

Thanks, Kaylen. I appreciate your support.

It's great! The location is really good and it's much bigger than my old place. Plus, it's newly renovated so everything is really nice and new.
I'm really glad you like the video, Sarah. I put a lot of work into it.
I can tell! It's really well done. You're very persuasive. I'm sure a lot of people will see it and be convinced to donate to the cause.

Absolutely. I think your video will definitely make people want to help out more.
Hey, Sarah. What's up?
Not much. Just hanging out at home.

Nope. Just the usual stuff. Went to school, then came home and did my homework. You?
Same here. I woke up, went to school, came home, and now I'm just chilling. But I am looking forward to the weekend! Are you doing anything fun?
Yeah, I'm going to a party on Saturday night with some friends. It should be really fun!
Hey Sarah, how's it going?
Good, just getting ready for my day. What about you?
I'm doing well too. I just wanted to tell you that I got an A on my math test!
That's great! Congratulations!
Thanks. I studied really hard for it and I'm just glad that it paid off.
Well, you've definitely done your homework. I'm sure you'll do great!
Hey Kohl. You've been looking kind of down lately. What's going on?

I care about you a lot, Kohl. We've been friends for a long time and I want to help you through whatever is going on.

Oh, Kohl. I'm so sorry. That must be really tough for you. Do you want to talk about it? I'm here for you, no matter what.

Kalani, of course! I wouldn't have missed it for the world. You're going to be amazing up there.

Don't worry, you'll do great. Just picture everyone in their underwear and you'll be fine. Trust me, it works like a charm!

Exactly! That's why I volunteer at the soup kitchen downtown. I feel like it's important to give back to the community and help those who are less fortunate.
Well, have a good time at the park and be sure to come back home safely.
